claim: A recording should start where the sprite and figure models can fill (the title) and reach the game's states; code reached only by unrecorded paths is proven by unit tests, not by replay.

evidence.text: A recording that starts mid-game leaves the sprite and figure models empty while the screen has figures; start every recording at the title, cheats poked into the start state.
The RZX covers levels 1-2 only; lifts are untouched by the patch and the free duck (same plotter call as the caged duck) is covered by unit tests.
Banks 3, 4 and 6 were never paged in either RZX (probably later islands); a recording past island 1 was needed.
